messages.text:
"Create a vibrant, stylized, top-down futuristic toy tower-defense game. Players place and upgrade counter-focused towers to stop varied enemies following branching paths and chokeholds across an escalating level campaign, with a unique boss at the end of every fifth stage, plus an endless mode. Support strategic preparation and clear combat feedback, including enemy health, tower range and stats, wave progress and arrival timing, and upcoming enemy previews. Between levels, players can invest earned currency in permanent upgrades. Include challenge modifiers, replayable progression, and global leaderboard support.HighlightsBuild a playable tower-defense loop with tower placement, distinct tower branches and upgrades, enemy counters, resource income and spending, and a winnable base-defense objective.Create varied levels with different paths and tower placement areas, increasing difficulty, boss encounters every five stages, and an endless mode; use changing environmental themes to distinguish stages.Show essential tactical information in the HUD: wave progress and timer, a five-wave enemy preview, selected tower stats and range with targeting priorities and sell control, and a prominent boss health bar with weakness icons.Add between-level Upgrade Lab investment, challenge modifiers with rewards, level selection, achievements, daily missions, post-level tower performance and achievement rewards, event notifications, pause and settings menus, and persistent local progress and game-session saves.

Make this have good graphics and detailed maps and a portrait mode orientation that works on phones (2D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
